direction: Preserve the user-approved voice. Violetto remains composed, precise and quietly caring. Emotion comes through modest intonation, pace and phrase pauses; words and mora sequences do not change. Never apply these settings to kana, vocabulary or pronunciation contrasts.

composed.label: Composed welcome
composed.description: An even greeting, with a little warmth when she welcomes you back.

warm.label: Gentle reassurance
warm.description: A softer pace after a mistake; patient, without pity.

proud.label: Quiet delight
proud.description: A small audible smile and a brighter lift when your effort pays off.

precise.label: Teacher focus
precise.description: Steady, deliberate delivery; a clear pause before the next step.

reflective.label: Thoughtful rest
reflective.description: A quieter close, with room between phrases to let the thought settle.
